_what: RiskyBird airframe expressed in dronesim's existing plant fields (vehicle/airframe.py names). Merge the 'plant' block into an experiment's plant overrides and the 'sensors' block into its sensors overrides. Nothing outside those two blocks is a dronesim field.

frame_conventions.origin: the board-centre datum on the PCB top surface (the same body origin the USD uses)
frame_conventions.com_m: relative to that origin (dronesim: arm = motor_position - com_m; truth pos is the origin)
frame_conventions.motor_positions_m: wire order FR, RR, RL, FL = PCB MOTOR1..4. z is the prop-plane height; the plant ignores it (the thrust force is along +z, so z drops out of the torque cross product)
frame_conventions.spin_signs: copied from dronesim airframe.py; reaction torque about +z = spin_sign * yaw_m_per_n * thrust. Unverified physically.
frame_conventions.inertia_kg_m2: diagonal of the full tensor about the CoM in body axes (Ixx, Iyy, Izz). The off-diagonals are <0.04% of the diagonal.
frame_conventions.body_size_m: dronesim centres this cuboid on the body origin and uses it for floor contact and ground placement only. x, y = the PCB bounding box; z = 2 x |lowest collider point| = 2 x 6.0 mm so that the cuboid bottom sits at the real lowest point (the JTAG connector). The cuboid cannot represent the 10.6 mm SoM stack, the rotors, or the actual landing set.
frame_conventions.sensor_offsets: relative to the body origin, identity rotation (dronesim: residual rotation after the firmware remap)

information_lost: off-diagonal inertia terms (about 0.04% of the diagonal; the principal axes are within 0.2 deg of the body axes)
the principal-axes rotation itself (dronesim forces the CoM-frame quaternion to identity; here it is ~0.2 deg)

the non-cuboid shape: the tall SoM and rotors, the H-shaped board, and the real landing set (JTAG connector, four PicoBlade connectors, camera bracket) all collapse into one centred cuboid; rest height and tilt behave differently
the asymmetric z extent: the cuboid is centred on the origin, the drone spans z from -6 mm to +20 mm
per-motor z (the plant uses x, y only); prop and rotor diameters (ground_effect.rotor_radius_m is a separate dronesim field, 0.0255 m already)
arm and motor geometry for collision
not_set_here: thrust curve, voltage scaling, lag, battery, drag, ground effect and contact fields keep their dronesim defaults; this file does not identify them
evidence: RiskyBird airframe v0.1.0: mass MEASURED-DOC, CoM and inertia INFERRED from a component model
